description: This file defines an abstract class RawPage within the namespace Todaymade\Daux\Format\Base, which implements the Page interface. It manages a filename property and provides methods for retrieving the filename and placeholders for raw content methods that throw exceptions.

classes.name: RawPage
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for page objects, managing file references and abstract content retrieval methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RawPage with a filename.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this page.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Method intended to retrieve raw content, but here it throws an exception indicating it should not be used directly.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Method intended to retrieve content, but here it throws an exception indicating it should not be used directly.
